parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific issue with the PasswordResetForm link in the UserAdmin, but it may introduce a regression risk due to the assumption about the URL structure.

issues.description: The change assumes that the UserAdmin URL structure will always be two levels deep, which may not be true for all configurations. This could lead to a behavioral regression if the URL structure is different.
